stories.title: Maryland jockey arrested by ICE in Ocean City, horsemen's group says
stories.summary: A Maryland jockey has been detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Ocean City, according to a Baltimore-based thoroughbred horsemen's group.

stories.title: Police seek help solving "targeted" fatal shooting that occurred in Anne Arundel County in 2024
stories.summary: Police in Anne Arundel County are seeking the public's health to help solve a fatal shooting in Glen Burnie in 2024 that claimed the life of a single mother.

stories.title: Maryland woman accused of lying about cancer indicted on felony theft charges
stories.summary: Lexi Thomas, a Maryland woman accused of lying about having cancer and raising thousands of dollars for her medical treatment, has been arrested in Howard County.

stories.title: Police investigate fatal shooting of man, 38, following crash in West Baltimore
stories.summary: A 38-year-old man was shot and killed Saturday afternoon in West Baltimore, following a traffic collision, according to Baltimore Police.

stories.title: Suspect arrested in connection with shooting death of 38-year-old man in West Baltimore
stories.summary: Police have arrested a suspect in connection with the fatal shooting on Saturday of a 38-year-old man in West Baltimore.

stories.title: How to make holiday meals and entertaining a less stressful in the kitchen
stories.summary: Sarah Klein from Klein’s Family Markets shares some easy and delicious recipes that are perfect for any Thanksgiving or holiday table spread.

stories.title: Book Club: Dive into these thrillers and holiday favorites with Harford County Public Library
stories.summary: From book page to movie screen, Harford County Public Library CEO Mary Hastler shares a few selections that have recently been adapted into movies and talks about the library's upcoming winter reading challenge.

stories.title: Velvet Cow Tallow is creating skincare that nourishes the skin without harsh chemicals or fillers
stories.summary: Owner Kimberly Stiff joins us in studio with a display of her products, and shares why her company is more than just skincare.

stories.title: Bowie State University's Concert Choir presents their 5th annual Messiah concert on December 6
stories.summary: Director and Professor Brandon J. Felder join us with members from the choir, to talk about the performance, which will be held at the MLK Auditorium on Sunday December 6, and share what attendees can expect this year.

stories.title: Around Town: Shop local this Thanksgiving holiday with Maryland's Best
stories.summary: Stephanie Douglas is live at Richardson Farms in White Marsh checking out their fresh produce, poultry and baked goods ahead of the big Thanksgiving holiday.

stories.title: Thanksgiving nor'easter to bring Maryland strong winds & rain
stories.summary: The WJZ First Alert Weather Team has issued a First Alert Weather Day for Thursday's nor'easter.

stories.title: BWI Airport facing one of busiest weeks of the year
stories.summary: Tuesday, Wednesday and Sunday are expected to be the busiest days at the airport this Thanksgiving week. WJZ-TV's Stephanie Douglas reports.
